name: New Ugly
summary: New Ugly (新丑风) is a counterculture graphic design style that is characterized by the use of intentionally jarring color palettes and element-heavy compositions.
description: New Ugly (新丑风) is a counterculture graphic design style that is characterized by the use of intentionally jarring color palettes and element-heavy compositions. The aesthetic takes inspiration in Asian convenience stores and bootleg or cheap packaging. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Rejecting the harmonious and polished visuals of commercial and artistic design. Reveling deliberately over-the-top and being the intensely authenticity.
